title: JBo
creator: CrossFit
description: A 28-minute AMRAP of 9 overhead squats and 12 bench presses at 115/75 lb. Honours U.S. Army Staff Sgt. Jeremie "JBo" Border, 1st Special Forces Group, killed by small-arms fire in Batur Village, Afghanistan, in 2012. Long and shoulder-heavy; one bar can serve both if you have a rack nearby.
